articles.title: BuilderIO/agent-native
articles.excerpt: A framework for building agentic apps
articles.summary: Builder.io 出品的框架，用于构建 agent 原生（agent-native）应用。把 AI agent 作为应用的一等公民，内置 agent 循环、工具调用与状态管理，开发者不必从零搭建底层编排。适合想快速把智能体能力嵌入产品的前端与全栈团队。

articles.title: trycua/cua
articles.excerpt: Scale computer-use 2.0 with open-source drivers, cross-OS fleets, and benchmarks for training, evaluation, and data generation.
articles.summary: 开源的计算机使用（computer-use）基础设施，提供跨操作系统的驱动、虚拟机机群编排以及训练评测基准，可用于生成 agent 操作电脑的数据并做评估。面向需要让 AI 代理操控桌面环境、批量并行跑任务的研发团队。

articles.title: Open-Dev-Society/OpenStock
articles.excerpt: OpenStock is an open-source alternative to expensive market platforms. Track real-time prices, set personalized alerts, and explore detailed company insights — built openly, for everyone, forever free.
articles.summary: 开源股票行情平台，定位为昂贵商业市场数据服务的替代品。支持实时价格追踪、个性化价格提醒和公司基本面详情，开放共建、永久免费。适合个人投资者与量化爱好者自建部署使用。

articles.title: akitaonrails/ai-memory
articles.excerpt: Solution for long term memory for agent coding CLIs and to facilitate handoff between different agent vendors
articles.summary: 为命令行 AI 编程助手提供长期记忆的方案，将跨会话的项目上下文持久化保存，并支持在不同厂商的 coding agent 之间迁移接续。解决换工具就丢上下文、反复交代背景的痛点，适合重度使用 Claude Code、Codex 等 CLI agent 的开发者。

articles.title: coder/coder
articles.excerpt: Secure environments for developers and their agents
articles.summary: 基于 Terraform 的开源平台，以声明式配置为开发者及其 AI agent 提供安全、一致的远程开发环境。可在自有云或本地基础设施上批量创建云端 IDE 与工作区，适合需要统一开发环境、兼顾安全隔离的企业工程团队。

articles.title: anthropics/financial-services
articles.summary: Anthropic 官方仓库，从命名看面向金融服务场景，可能包含 Claude 在金融行业的示例、工具或最佳实践。目前仓库未提供描述，具体内容与适用范围需查阅代码和文档确认。

articles.title: cloudflare/quiche
articles.excerpt: 🥧 Savoury implementation of the QUIC transport protocol and HTTP/3
articles.summary: Cloudflare 用 Rust 实现的 QUIC 传输协议与 HTTP/3 库，属于生产级实现，已用于其边缘网络。提供低延迟、加密的传输能力，适合需要在服务端或客户端集成 QUIC/HTTP3 的网络与基础设施开发者。

articles.title: mvt-project/mvt
articles.excerpt: MVT (Mobile Verification Toolkit) helps with conducting forensics of mobile devices in order to find signs of a potential compromise.
articles.summary: 移动设备取证工具包（Mobile Verification Toolkit），用于检测 iPhone 和 Android 手机是否被间谍软件感染。通过分析设备备份、系统日志与 IOC 指标发现入侵痕迹，常被记者、人权组织和安全研究人员用于调查 Pegasus 类攻击。

articles.title: zhouxiaoka/autoclip
articles.excerpt: AutoClip : AI-powered video clipping and highlight generation · 一款智能高光提取与剪辑的二创工具
articles.summary: AI 驱动的视频剪辑与高光提取工具，自动从长视频中切出精彩片段并生成成片，面向影视解说、游戏集锦等二创场景。借助语音识别与大模型理解内容、完成切片与字幕，降低手工剪辑成本。

articles.title: ruanyf/weekly
articles.excerpt: 科技爱好者周刊，每周五发布

articles.title: Crosstalk-Solutions/project-nomad
articles.excerpt: Project NOMAD is an offline-first knowledge and education server. Wikipedia, thousands of books, courses, maps, and optional local AI, all running on hardware you own with no internet required.
articles.summary: 离线优先的知识与教育服务器，在自有硬件上自托管维基百科、数千本书籍、课程和地图，可选接入本地 AI 模型，全程无需联网。适合断网环境、偏远地区，或希望数据自主可控的家庭与机构。

articles.title: yynxxxxx/Codex-X
articles.excerpt: OpenAI Codex 桌面端/CLI 的可视化管理工具，具有Provider/API 切换、会话同步、提示词注入、Skills/MCP 管理、TOML 配置可视化的跨平台工具。
articles.summary: OpenAI Codex 桌面端与 CLI 的可视化管理工具，支持 Provider/API 切换、会话同步、提示词注入，以及 Skills、MCP 与 TOML 配置的可视化编辑，跨平台运行。适合同时使用多家模型供应商、需要统一管理 Codex 会话的开发者。

articles.title: Saving another 100TB of RAM with math (and Rust)
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare's global network is immense but not limitless. As we look for small ways to trim our resource usage, we sometimes get lucky and we can cut significantly more. Here’s how we reduced one of our Pingora-based service's RAM usage with statistics.

articles.title: When scanners miss the attack: how Cloudflare Client-Side Security protects storefronts
articles.excerpt: A modern storefront can look healthy while malicious JavaScript quietly siphons revenue, hijacks clicks, or rewrites analytics. See how Cloudflare's machine learning models surface evasive client-side attacks for analyst investigation.

articles.title: Have it both ways: stay discoverable in search while disallowing AI training
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare is giving site owners a way to stay discoverable while disallowing AI training. New controls and an Accountable designation establish a shared model with Apple, Google, and Microsoft.

articles.title: Give every teammate and agent the right level of access to your Workers
articles.excerpt: You can now scope access to individual Workers and assign narrower Developer Platform roles, so teammates, CI tokens, and agents get only the access they need to debug, deploy, or monitor safely.

articles.title: Introducing automatic remediation policies with Cloudflare CASB
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare CASB policies introduce a native automation engine built directly on the Cloudflare developer platform to remediate SaaS risks automatically. Security teams can now design event-driven logic to revoke risky file shares and send webhooks without manual intervention.

articles.title: 1.1.1.1 now supports post-quantum DNSSEC, all 2,420 bytes of it
articles.excerpt: 1.1.1.1 now validates DNSSEC signatures using NIST’s post-quantum ML-DSA-44 algorithm. Here is how we manage 2,420-byte signatures and downgrade risks at scale.

articles.title: How we rebuilt Cloudflare Workers’ module registry for Node.js compatibility
articles.excerpt: Workers now enables Node.js compatibility by default, supports applications up to 64 mebibytes, and adds a URL-based module registry with import.meta, lazy compilation, shared code caches, and clearer errors.

articles.title: Automatic Key Exchange: faster, post-quantum secure origin handshakes for 45 billion daily connections (and counting)
articles.excerpt: Automatic Key Exchange probes TLS 1.3-capable customer origins to learn which key agreement algorithms they support. We then lead with the most secure algorithm when connecting to the origin, preferring post-quantum connections wherever the origin supports it.

articles.title: Introducing context-aware vulnerability discovery and remediation with Cloudflare Managed Defense and OpenAI Daybreak models
articles.excerpt: Use production traffic and security signals to prioritize findings, prepare edge mitigations when safe, and propose code patches. By combining WAF data with OpenAI Daybreak models, Vulnerability Discovery and Remediation helps teams identify and patch the most critical threats first.

articles.title: How we could save petabytes of cache storage with Zstandard and Pingora
articles.excerpt: Could we get more cache space with the same hardware? We prototyped compression inside Cloudflare's cache to find out.

articles.title: Introducing Adaptive Intelligence: Undermining the economics of every bot attack
articles.excerpt: Bot operators have historically had the economic advantage, bypassing static, deterministic detection rules with cheap proxies and retooling. Cloudflare's new Adaptive Intelligence engine flips this dynamic by autonomously learning from the meta-signals of live traffic and deploying disposable rules

articles.title: BotBase for Operators: A clearer path to joining Cloudflare's directory of bots and agents

articles.title: How we saved 100 terabytes of memory by optimizing 1.1.1.1’s DNS cache
articles.excerpt: Five Rust-level memory optimizations to the DNS cache layout of Big Pineapple cut per-entry memory by 56%, freeing approximately 100 TB of memory across Cloudflare's fleet.

articles.title: The Cloudflare Blog — brought to you by EmDash

articles.title: Say it once: introducing Bot Preference Sync
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare's new Bot Preference Sync automatically aligns your robots.txt file with your AI bot policies for Search, Agent, and Training. Easily manage which bots access your content without maintaining static files.

articles.title: From all-or-nothing to task-based OAuth consent
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare OAuth now supports optional scopes, giving users more control over what an app can access and helping developers build secure consent flows around the task at hand.

articles.title: A revisit of remote Spectre attacks on Cloudflare Workers
articles.excerpt: In 2024 and 2025, we reassessed remote Spectre attacks on our Workers infrastructure. We share details about the new attack primitives like Spectre gadgets, remote timers, achieving co-location and how new defenses further harden Cloudflare Workers.

articles.title: BGP Role model: tracking the adoption of RFC 9234
articles.excerpt: RFC 9234 lets routers reject route leaks on their own, using BGP Roles and the Only to Customer attribute. We measured who has deployed it, and found two Tier 1 networks unexpectedly stripping OTC.

articles.title: How Cloudflare detects MCP traffic and helps secure it
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare Gateway identifies MCP requests using protocol-level heuristics. Security teams can use that signal to find shadow MCP traffic, enforce Portal-only access for approved servers, and block direct connections on managed network paths.
